reuse.why: Reuses recurConfigToRSchedule, RSchedule and the shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but re-implements the daily-schedule weekend-skip rule that shared/schedules.ts getNextDate already encodes, instead of extracting one 'final day of an occurrence' helper.

duplication.why: The RSchedule/try/captureBreadcrumb scaffold is copied from getUpcomingDates and the skipWeekend/daily/solve-mode dispatch is a third copy of logic living in getNextDate and getUpcomingDates.

placement.why: The handler sits next to getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and is registered the same way, though the occurrence-to-final-day rule belongs in shared/schedules.ts.

scope.why: Only the new handler, its registration/type and focused tests.

maintainability.why: Readable and small, but a change to weekend handling now has to be made in three places (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange).

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses getDateWithSkippedWeekend; there is no shared final-day helper to bypass, the daily rule is inline in getNextDate.

disguised_duplication.where: server/schedules/app.ts getDatesInRange map(): the skipWeekend / daily-skip / getDateWithSkippedWeekend dispatch of getNextDate and getUpcomingDates rewritten as early-return ifs.
